title: 1701 Prairie's rear veranda and the back range's oriel
items: Behind the Hibbard house, a two-level veranda now stands against the rear wall: paired posts, a band of spindles, railed decks, and steps down to the lawn, all read off the old rear photograph.
The 1874 back range has its corbelled oriel at the upper storey, and its windows now sit where the photograph shows them.
